purpose: pipeline fidelity at the canonical resolution: the probe must reproduce the frozen Phase-21 pipeline before any scale claim
comparison_space: CANONICAL_512_SQUARE_CANVAS (reference maps are stored in that canvas, so the probe is compared there; all REPORTED metrics are computed in NATIVE image space)

gate_A_pipeline_fidelity.test: probe re-inference at 512 (canonical rule) vs the canonical persisted PROBABILITY map re-thresholded by the same rule
gate_A_pipeline_fidelity.note: A residual disagreement that is confined to pixels whose probability lies within 0.02 of the 0.5 threshold is float16 storage quantisation, not a pipeline divergence. Sizes are recorded so the magnitude is always visible.

gate_B_probability_map_agreement.test: probe re-inference at 512 vs the canonical persisted PROBABILITY map, maximum absolute difference in the shared 512 square canvas
gate_B_probability_map_agreement.note: float16 storage quantisation bounds agreement; a difference at or below 5e-3 is consistent with the 512-px decode round-trip and does not indicate a pipeline divergence.

gate_C_disagreement_with_stored_pred.test: probe (canonical rule) vs the canonical persisted PRED array
gate_C_disagreement_with_stored_pred.known_cause: the persisted float16 probability map cannot represent the float32 threshold decision; exact-0.5 pixels in the stored map are MIXED (foreground and background) in the stored pred, so pred is not a function of prob on disk

dice_by_decision_source.note: Dice is insensitive to the float16 tie artefact at this scale; all three agree to ~1e-4.
